svg.title: MR.3 saved-location and keyboard-aware search UI artwork board
svg.desc: Product-owner-approved UI artwork for the visible search field above the on-screen keyboard, keyboard dismissal after search, and saved-location LIVE catalog handoff.
svg.text: MR.3 — Location search & saved-location return
UI artwork board · preserve the existing city scene and controls while the affected states remain visible
OWNER APPROVED · 2026-11-10
Search field stays above the system IME → Enter/Search hides the IME → saved-location View returns only after LIVE activation succeeds.
A · SEARCH FIELD, IME, AND RESULTS
Keep the same selector scene; make the query visible in both affected states
CURRENT · FIELD OBSCURED
Installed: field hidden by IME.
TARGET · KEYBOARD OPEN

g.text: Query remains visible · typing has not submitted

svg.text: Query stays visible above the IME.
TARGET · AFTER ENTER/SEARCH
Query and results visible; IME hidden.
ART DIRECTION & BOUNDARIES
Keep the approved location-search language
• Retain the full-screen city scene, dark overlay, white place/context text, and shared location rail.
• Keep the existing rounded search field, clear action, Search action, and explicit Save / View controls.
• Preserve green for the current saved place, gold for a focused result, and turquoise for the primary action.
• Use the system IME as shown only to communicate placement; its key appearance is not being redesigned.
While typing
The field and current query remain fully visible above the IME. Editing alone does not submit
or change the focused/selected place; allow the existing scene content to reflow as needed.
After Enter/Search
Dismiss the keyboard automatically, retain the query, and show the existing search state in the
same selector: loading, matches, no matches, or failure. The WX.29 v2 board still governs
status placement, saved-rail continuity, retry treatment, and result presentation.
No automatic selection
Submitting leaves Save / View as explicit user actions. No provider, persistence, weather, or
device-location behavior changes in this slice. Sample place labels are illustrative only.
B · SAVED-LOCATION VIEW AND LIVE-CATALOG HANDOFF
Keep the selector open while LIVE loads; dismiss only on successful activation
VIEW · LIVE LOAD PENDING
Selector stays open during LIVE load.
LIVE success
SUCCESS · MAIN WEATHER VIEW
Success shows the selected LIVE catalog.
OR
FAILURE · STAYS OPEN
Keep existing failure and retry available.
State transition cues
Choose View to start selection and LIVE activation.
While pending, keep the selector, chosen place, and
loading status visible.
LIVE success → close selector and show that location's
main weather view.
LIVE failure → keep selector open and preserve the
existing failure feedback and recovery action.
Scope guard
The temporary-result View path, selection persistence, selected
forecast time, provider attribution, and timeline remain as they
are. This artwork is a target, not installed acceptance evidence.
The main-screen capture shows the currently installed Florence example;
at target success, its selected location and LIVE values are dynamic.
References: connected Pixel 3 XL captures from 2026-11-10 · app 0.1.0-prototype · approved WX.29 UI states v2 · existing city-scene artwork · all sample places/results illustrative.
